text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What she talked about with her two 
colleagues was each of their respective 
partners. Just how much they could trust 
their partner—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging fiery words and pledging their 
best efforts, they deepened their trust in 
<chrname> even further!
